------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Geist and Geist Mono typefaces

This package includes the Geist and Geist Mono typefaces, which the SIL Open Font
License, Version 1.1 covers (text below). The Apache License covering the rest of
this package does not apply to these files.

Files, unmodified:
  dist/fonts/geist-latin-wght-normal.woff2
    29400 bytes, sha256 19f9c92546aa300c312235e3125af1b81394d8db9a4bc4a425cd5b641d2d54e1
  dist/fonts/geist-latin-ext-wght-normal.woff2
    16512 bytes, sha256 824f485b5d26e2f2da3c2b236132ece1bc8e4e43373452950bb0e40548b4313f
  dist/fonts/geist-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2
    23128 bytes, sha256 684ad5b531f81d43c1e8c7038262d5db7cdc1f68006e04d6c7769efa8d33c8cc
  dist/fonts/geist-mono-latin-ext-wght-normal.woff2
    14696 bytes, sha256 1a189eb997c3e2ece68373e387afaec9e8617424186c4b1ab3cff7c54ba6223b

What they are: Geist and Geist Mono, normal style, variable weight 100-900, Latin
and Latin Extended subsets. Google Fonts publishes Geist as version v5, last
modified 2026-05-13, and Geist Mono as version v6, last modified 2026-06-08.

Where they come from: @fontsource-variable/geist 5.3.0, the files
files/geist-latin-wght-normal.woff2 and files/geist-latin-ext-wght-normal.woff2
(https://registry.npmjs.org/@fontsource-variable/geist/-/geist-5.3.0.tgz,
tarball sha256 533dd66117795ac12316fb05fce27736c4bc63c31613b302d0a5285ca3a291d7),
and @fontsource-variable/geist-mono 5.3.0, the files
files/geist-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2 and
files/geist-mono-latin-ext-wght-normal.woff2
(https://registry.npmjs.org/@fontsource-variable/geist-mono/-/geist-mono-5.3.0.tgz,
tarball sha256 af7a9f156602b859efa95cd1acb824a5322c51a1eca53afb38ed033885736a70).
Those packages serve Google Fonts' Geist and Geist Mono (https://github.com/google/fonts),
built from https://github.com/vercel/geist-font.

The OFL allows the licensed fonts to be used, studied, modified and
redistributed freely as long as they are not sold by themselves. The

"Modified Version" refers to any derivative made by adding to, deleting,
